items.title: The determinant of a short exact sequence of finite locally free modules is the tensor product of the determinants
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a canonical isomorphism from the tensor product of the determinants of the outer terms of a short exact sequence of finite locally free modules to the determinant of the middle term (author lemma at source lines 4694-4706, label lemma-det-ses). The proof (source lines 4708-4731) reduces to the case of constant ranks by splitting the space into open and closed pieces, then defines the comparison map on the tensor product of the two exterior powers by wedging local sections of the submodule with lifts of local sections of the quotient (proof lines 4712-4729). The construction of the map is the content; the author closes by stating that the details of the verification are omitted, and the card records that remark verbatim in the proof span. H2.
